segments.title: Classes
blocks: Reaver — frontline fighters bound by clan oath
Ashwalker — scouts and skirmishers trained in the ridgelands
Hollow-Chanter — spellcasters who speak to ancestor spirits

segments.title: Culture & Rites
blocks: Naming customs — clan name precedes given name, earned after first hunt
Death rites — ash-burial facing the home ridge; a lit tallow candle for one year
Clan structure — matrilineal council of five elders, one seat rotates yearly

segments.title: Notable NPCs
blocks: Vethra Ashclan leads the council and distrusts outsiders more than she lets on. She lost a daughter to the Ridgeland Compact's border raids and has never forgiven the human factions for it.

segments.title: The Ridgeland Compact
blocks: A loose alliance of border towns that formally treats with the Orc clans but quietly arms its militias against them. Players who side with the Compact will find Orc settlements closed to them.
